name: Noam Jenkins
bio: Noam Jenkins (born 31 December 1983, Paris, France) is a French-Canadian actor and screenwriter based in Toronto. He is best known as Detective Jerry Barber on Rookie Blue (2010–2012) and as the voice of Aiden Pearce in Watch Dogs (2014). In film, he has appeared in Saw II (2005), John Q (2002), and Adoration (2008). On television he has had recurring roles on Wynonna Earp, Longmire, and Reacher.
